# Correctness verdict: BLOCK

PR #208 at `a552625169d54b45015c6681b689da334b470987`, answering `01a1bf0a-68ef-7c23-9203-9522895b4834`. One bounded-message correctness finding under C34.

**F001: the claimed 2 KB cap excludes the footer.** `limit_body` collects a release command for every distinct role instance/project (`crates/daemon/src/delivery/role_send.rs:1830-1859`) and appends that footer unconditionally (`:1896`). Thirty ordinary `reviewer/<PR>` release hints alone produce a **2,372-byte footer**, before the header and request list. Such requests group together by recipient/holder/kind, so this is a valid batch, not malformed input. The 60-request test deduplicates to one release hint and misses it.

**Fix:** bound the whole message, including recovery hints, while retaining the omitted-count summary. A compact generic hint or hints only for displayed entries suffices; add a distinct-instance cap case. The byte calculation is a source counterexample, not execution of the Rust function.

**Failure safety checked:** requests are only stamped after a delivered/queued/held outcome. Refused/error/no-recipient members release their claims for retry (`role_send.rs:1522-1593`); interrupted claims expire, and pinned admission recovery remains. No premature-stamp/lost-on-failed-send finding. Existing post-admission stamp-failure duplicates remain the documented Known limit.

Exact-head CI `42573708131`, artifact `13654273061`: **2,341 Rust passes**, six separately skipped. Grouped delivery, same-instance cap and no-recipient/interrupted-claim retry cases executed. Latest five checks pass; `pr-freeze` FINAL/CLEAN; CI/head tree `705284167a3cd8db3a9e2fcd566b1bf5dfbbad4e`. No local builds/tests, product edits or HEAD movement.
